{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Verify premises
print("- 'new' is in customer_segment:", 'new' in data['customer_segment'].unique())
print("- 'paid_search' is in channel:", 'paid_search' in data['channel'].unique())
print("- 'converted' is 0 or 1:", sorted(data['converted'].unique().tolist()))
print("- Status values:", sorted(data['status'].unique().tolist()))

# Filter for the population: new customers reached by paid_search
filtered_data = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print("Number of rows in population:", len(filtered_data))

# Remove QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
filtered_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['revenue'] != '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders removed:", len(data) - len(filtered_data))

# Only keep completed orders
completed_only = filtered_data[filtered_data['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders in this group:", len(completed_only))

# Compute conversion rate
if len(completed_only) == 0:
    conversion_rate = 0.0
else:
    conversion_rate = completed_only['converted'].mean()

print("Conversion rate:", conversion_rate)"}
